title: Tom Holland Reveals Christopher Nolan's Athena Casting Choice for 'The Odyssey'
summary: Actor Tom Holland shared that he informed actress Zendaya about director Christopher Nolan's preference to cast her as Athena in his upcoming film adaptation of Homer's epic poem, 'The Odyssey'. The movie has received early praise from critics, who describe it as a 'spectacular epic'. The project marks Nolan's foray into adapting ancient Greek literature. This news highlights the intersection of Hollywood and classical literature.
summary_points: Tom Holland shared that he informed Zendaya about Christopher Nolan's preference to cast her as Athena in 'The Odyssey'.
Critics have praised the film as a 'spectacular epic'.
This marks Christopher Nolan's first adaptation of ancient Greek literature.
The project brings together Hollywood and classical literature.
No official release date has been announced for the film.
